digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate, LLM agent control stack
propositions: The runaway guard layer counts memo-served (cached) repeats as loop evidence because the guard sits outermost and observes calls before the memo layer answers them, causing legitimate verifier file re-reads to trip RunawayToolLoopError despite being free cache hits.

The guard and memo layers fight each other: lever 2 made repeats cheap via path-normalized read_file memoization, but the guard still penalizes them in its distinct-ratio window, causing authors to resort to --force on legitimately complete tickets.

The fix recomposes guard and memo via a shared ToolCallLedger that distinguishes executed vs cache-served calls: the ratio arm evaluates only executed work (so memo-served repeats no longer trip it), and a served-streak backstop still bounds pure cache-served loops.

The memo layer calls record_executed at exactly five points where work reaches wrapped tools: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, read_file unparseable-path fallback, read_file first-read, and truncated-window exact-range fallback on long files.
Layer composition remains Guard→Memo→Steering unchanged; completion-policy visibility is unaffected; memo-served calls never record, so they extend the served-streak only.
